description: Pull pending Pipedrive webhook events for this tenant (requires a webhook registered via create_pipedrive_webhook — see that tool). NOTE: there is no server-side push/cron in this project, so this only surfaces events queued since the last time this tool was called — call it periodically/on each active turn to react to Pipedrive changes. Returned events are marked consumed immediately (at-most-once delivery) so they won't repeat on the next call.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

name: list_pipedrive_events
